title.narrative: Urgent Action Fund - Africa, 2026-2028, CSO-strategy - Urgent Action Fund Africa, CSO-strategy 2026-2028

description.narrative:
Insatsens mål består av ett övergripande impact-mål samt tre outcomes (resultatmål) som uttrycker de huvudsakliga förändringar programmet strävar efter att bidra till.
Det övergripande målet för insatsen är: An enabling environment for AWHRDs, womens rights organisations (WROs) and their formations to sustain their activism, improve living conditions and to advance womens human rights within their contexts.
Det övergripande målet ska uppnås genom tre resultatmål som programmet ska rapportera mot:
1. Increased access to resources for AWHRDs and WROs to rapidly respond and strengthen their institutional capacities to respond to multi-layered crisis, closure of civic space and emerging opportunities as they occur in their contexts.
2. Increased effectiveness of AWHRDs, WROs and movements to work collectively to advance democracy and counter the push-back against gender equality and women's rights
3. Strengthened philanthropic advocacy, donor-influencing, generation of new and innovative knowledge to advance civic engagement, human rights and protection of AWHRDs and WROs
Insatsen ska bidra till två av de globala målen för hållbar utveckling enligt Agenda 2030: 5. Jämställdhet och 16. Fredliga och inkluderande samhällen.

Det övergripande målet för insatsen är: An enabling environment for AWHRDs, women’s rights organisations (WROs) and their formations to sustain their activism, improve living conditions and to advance women’s human rights within their contexts.
Det övergripande målet ska uppnås genom tre resultatmål som programmet ska rapportera mot:
1. Increased access to resources for AWHRDs and WROs to rapidly respond and strengthen their institutional capacities to respond to multi-layered crisis, closure of civic space and emerging opportunities as they occur in their contexts.
2. Increased effectiveness of AWHRDs, WROs and movements to work collectively to advance democracy and counter the push-back against gender equality and women's rights
3. Strengthened philanthropic advocacy, donor-influencing, generation of new and innovative knowledge to advance civic engagement, human rights and protection of AWHRDs and WROs

1. Increased access to resources for AWHRDs and WROs to rapidly respond and strengthen their institutional capacities to respond to multi-layered crisis, closure of civic space and emerging opportunities as they occur in their contexts.
2. Increased effectiveness of AWHRDs, WROs and movements to work collectively to advance democracy and counter the push-back against gender equality and women's rights
3. Strengthened philanthropic advocacy, donor-influencing, generation of new and innovative knowledge to advance civic engagement, human rights and protection of AWHRDs and WROs

The overall objective of the contribution is: An enabling environment for AWHRDs, women’s rights organizations (WROs), and their networks to sustain their activism, improve living conditions, and advance women’s human rights within their respective contexts.
The overall objective is to be achieved through three outcome targets against which the program will report:
1. Increased access to resources for AWHRDs and WROs to rapidly respond and strengthen their institutional capacities to respond to multi-layered crisis, closure of civic space and emerging opportunities as they occur in their contexts.
2. Increased effectiveness of AWHRDs, WROs and movements to work collectively to advance democracy and counter the push-back against gender equality and women's rights
3. Strengthened philanthropic advocacy, donor-influencing, generation of new and innovative knowledge to advance civic engagement, human rights and protection of AWHRDs and WROs

16.3 - Promote the rule of law at the national and international levels and ensure equal access to justice for all.
16.7 - Ensure responsive, inclusive, participatory and representative decision-making at all levels.
16.7 - Säkerställa ett lyhört, inkluderande, deltagandebaserat och representativt beslutsfattande på alla nivåer.
16.b - Promote and enforce non-discriminatory laws and policies for sustainable development.

5.1 - Avskaffa alla former av diskriminering av alla kvinnor och flickor överallt
5.1 - End all forms of discrimination against all women and girls everywhere.
5.5 - Ensure women’s full and effective participation and equal opportunities for leadership at all levels of decision-making in political, economic and public life.
5.5 - Tillförsäkra kvinnor fullt och faktiskt deltagande och lika möjligheter till ledarskap på alla beslutsnivåer i det politiska, ekonomiska och offentliga livet.

5.a - Genomföra reformer för att ge kvinnor lika rätt till ekonomiska resurser, möjlighet att äga och kontrollera mark och andra former av egendom samt tillgång till finansiella tjänster, arv och naturresurser, i enlighet med nationell lagstiftning

5.a - Undertake reforms to give women equal rights to economic resources, as well as access to ownership and control over land and other forms of property, financial services, inheritance and natural resources, in accordance with national laws.
5.c - Adopt and strengthen sound policies and enforceable legislation for the promotion of gender equality and the empowerment of all women and girls at all levels.
5.c - Anta och stärka välgrundad politik och genomförbar lagstiftning för att främja jämställdhet och öka alla kvinnors och flickors egenmakt på alla nivåer
